Name: Victor Dialogue Expansion
Author: iamBLAZEfr
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]Victor Dialogue Expansion V1[/b] is a complete narrative overhaul designed to bring Pelican Town’s most meticulous engineer to life. The main purpose of this mod is to transform Victor from a static NPC into a living, evolving partner by injecting over 335+ custom, personality-driven dialogue lines that respond dynamically to your farm's progress, seasonal shifts, and major life milestones.

[*][b]Install Prerequisites[/b]: Ensure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/375]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] installed in your game directory.[/*]
[*][b]Download[/b]: Download the [b]Victor Dialogue Expansion V1[/b] archive from this page.[/*]
[*][b]Extract[/b]: Open the archive and extract the folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*][b]Launch[/b]: Run the game using the SMAPI launcher.

[b][size=4]Main Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Comprehensive Dialogue Overhaul:[/b] Adds over 335 unique dialogue nodes that shuffle dynamically across random cycles, seasons, and multi-year progression.[/*]
[*][b]Immersive Spousal System:[/b] Victor features dynamic farmhouse routines, including morning breakfast preparation, evening unwinding, and reactive commentary on your farm's daily output.[/*]
[*][b]Festival Integration:[/b] Custom interaction trees for all vanilla festivals, as well as full routing for Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village events.[/*]
[*][b]Reactive Environment Logic:[/b] Victor provides unique commentary on local weather anomalies like Green Rain, as well as structural milestones like your house upgrades and fish pond installations.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Career Paths:[/b] Experience branching, character-driven story choices regarding Victor's professional future in Zuzu City versus his life with you in the valley.[/*]
[/list][b][i]Note:[/i][/b] This is only the beginning! A much more detailed expansion, featuring deeper heart-event chains and even more complex interaction branches, is currently in development and coming soon.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]: The Stardew Modding API.[/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b]: Required to inject the new dialogue strings into the game.[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]: Recommended for full integration with all scheduled event paths.[/*]
[*][b]Ridgeside Village[/b]: Optional; the mod includes built-in conditional logic to support Ridgeside Village festivals if installed.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Shout Outs[/b][/size]
A massive thank you to the Stardew Valley modding community for creating the tools that make custom character storytelling possible. Special thanks to the developers of Content Patcher for their incredible framework, and to the creators of Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village for providing such a rich world to build upon. Finally, thank you to everyone who encouraged me to share this project—I hope Victor brings as much joy to your farmhouse as he has to mine.






[/*]
